questions.explanation: 根据上下文，作者原以为它和其他冠军狗一样，但立刻“认出/察觉”(recognized)了它的独特之处。A(changed)改变；B(rejected)拒绝；C(improved)改善，均不合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(changed)：语境句：He has changed a lot since we last met. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change into
B(rejected)：语境句：The committee rejected his proposal due to a lack of funds. 固定搭配：reject an offer, firmly reject
C(improved)：语境句：Her spoken English has improved significantly over the past year. 固定搭配：improve dramatically, room for improvement
D(recognized)：语境句：I recognized my old friend immediately in the crowd. 固定搭配：recognize the importance of, be widely recognized

questions.explanation: 狗歪着头，棕色的眼睛“追踪/观察”(tracking)孩子们微小的面部表情。B(terrifying)使恐惧；C(causing)引起；D(avoiding)避免，与治疗犬温和的天性不符。
questions.supplement:
A(tracking)：语境句：The scientists are tracking the movement of the endangered birds. 固定搭配：keep track of, track down
B(terrifying)：语境句：The loud thunder was a terrifying experience for the little girl. 固定搭配：terrifying experience, terrifying thought
C(causing)：语境句：The heavy rain is causing massive traffic jams in the city. 固定搭配：cause trouble, cause damage
D(avoiding)：语境句：He is deliberately avoiding answering my questions. 固定搭配：avoid doing sth, try to avoid

questions.explanation: 因为这只狗善于观察人类的细微表情，说明它具有“富有洞察力的”(insightful)天性，因此作者决定把它训练成治疗犬。A(graceful)优雅的；C(amusing)有趣的；D(dominant)占优势的，均不符合逻辑连贯性。
questions.supplement:
A(graceful)：语境句：The dancers performed with graceful movements on the stage. 固定搭配：graceful movements, graceful manner
B(insightful)：语境句：The professor provided an insightful analysis of the economic crisis. 固定搭配：insightful comments, insightful observation
C(amusing)：语境句：He told us an amusing story that made everyone laugh. 固定搭配：amusing anecdote, highly amusing
D(dominant)：语境句：The company has maintained a dominant position in the global market. 固定搭配：dominant role, dominant position

questions.explanation: 它的工作是去“访问”(visit)小学班级听学生读书。下文提到的“Over 200 school visits”也直接提示了该选项。B(design)设计；C(interrupt)打断；D(instruct)指导，均不符合狗作为陪伴者的身份。
questions.supplement:
A(visit)：语境句：We plan to visit several historical museums during the trip. 固定搭配：pay a visit to, return a visit
B(design)：语境句：The architect was hired to design a new library for the university. 固定搭配：custom design, design specifically for
C(interrupt)：语境句：Please do not interrupt me while I am speaking. 固定搭配：interrupt a conversation, be frequently interrupted
D(instruct)：语境句：The teacher instructed the students to complete the assignment in silence. 固定搭配：instruct sb to do sth, strictly instruct

questions.explanation: undivided attention 是固定搭配，意为“全神贯注”。这只狗对读书的孩子全神贯注地倾听，从不打断。A(unwanted)不需要的；B(uncomfortable)不舒服的；D(unusual)不寻常的。
questions.supplement:
A(unwanted)：语境句：He threw away all the unwanted items in his room. 固定搭配：unwanted attention, unwanted pregnancy
B(uncomfortable)：语境句：These tight shoes are making me feel uncomfortable. 固定搭配：feel uncomfortable, an uncomfortable silence
C(undivided)：语境句：Please give me your undivided attention while I explain the rules. 固定搭配：undivided attention, undivided loyalty
D(unusual)：语境句：It is unusual for him to be late for such an important meeting. 固定搭配：highly unusual, quite unusual

questions.explanation: 读完书后，孩子们可以把一块“零食/狗粮”(treat)放在它鼻子上，狗会将其抛起接住，这是常见的奖励狗的行为。A(page)页码；C(coin)硬币；D(hand)手，均不符合逗狗的常理。
questions.supplement:
A(page)：语境句：Please turn to the next page of the textbook. 固定搭配：front page, blank page
B(treat)：语境句：She gave her dog a treat for learning a new trick. 固定搭配：dog treat, as a special treat
C(coin)：语境句：He flipped a coin to decide who would go first. 固定搭配：flip a coin, coin collecting
D(hand)：语境句：Could you give me a hand with these heavy boxes? 固定搭配：give sb a hand, hand in hand

questions.explanation: 一天，一个特教学生“加入”(joined)了我们的课堂。A(witnessed)目击；B(led)带领；D(invited)邀请，均与语境“学生来到班级一起活动”不符。
questions.supplement:
A(witnessed)：语境句：Several bystanders witnessed the traffic accident yesterday. 固定搭配：witness a crime, bear witness to
B(led)：语境句：The local guide led the tourists through the dense forest. 固定搭配：lead to, lead the way
C(joined)：语境句：Would you like to join us for dinner tonight? 固定搭配：join in, join hands with
D(invited)：语境句：They invited all their relatives to the wedding ceremony. 固定搭配：invite sb over, invite sb to do sth

questions.explanation: 结合男孩发抖的膝盖(shaking knees)以及后面话语卡在喉咙里的描述，说明这个特教男孩十分“费力地”(with great effort)在尝试读书。B(respect)尊重；C(risk)风险；D(speed)速度，都不符合努力克服阅读障碍的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(effort)：语境句：She passed the difficult exam with great effort. 固定搭配：make an effort, spare no effort
B(respect)：语境句：We should show respect for people from different cultural backgrounds. 固定搭配：show respect for, earn respect
C(risk)：语境句：Investing in the stock market always involves a certain degree of risk. 固定搭配：take a risk, at the risk of
D(speed)：语境句：The car was traveling at a high speed when it crashed. 固定搭配：at top speed, speed up

questions.explanation: 男孩因为结巴读不出单词，话“卡在”(got stuck)喉咙里。A(turned up)出现；C(spread out)散开；D(came true)实现。
questions.supplement:
A(turned up)：语境句：We waited for an hour, but he never turned up. 固定搭配：turn up the volume, turn up late
B(got stuck)：语境句：My car got stuck in the mud and couldn't move. 固定搭配：get stuck in traffic, get stuck in a rut
C(spread out)：语境句：The search party spread out to cover more ground. 固定搭配：spread out the map, widely spread
D(came true)：语境句：After years of hard work, his dream of becoming an actor finally came true. 固定搭配：come true, a dream come true

questions.explanation: 狗主动帮助男孩，用冰凉的“鼻子”(nose)推了推印有帽子的那一页。狗的鼻子特征为cool，且下文提到Henry smelt the book(狗闻书)，均暗示是狗的鼻子。A(wind)风；B(teacher)老师；C(finger)手指。
questions.supplement:
A(wind)：语境句：The strong wind blew away the autumn leaves. 固定搭配：strong wind, catch one's wind
B(teacher)：语境句：She is a dedicated teacher who inspires her students. 固定搭配：head teacher, strict teacher
C(finger)：语境句：He pointed a finger at the map to show the location. 固定搭配：point a finger at, cross one's fingers
D(nose)：语境句：The dog used its nose to sniff out the hidden food. 固定搭配：under one's nose, a running nose

questions.explanation: 老师说了一句“太棒了！”，作者以为她指的是狗很棒，所以回答说它确实是只好狗。mean在此处意为“指代、意思是”。A(encouraged)鼓励；B(ordered)命令；C(compared)比较。
questions.supplement:
A(encouraged)：语境句：My parents always encouraged me to pursue my dreams. 固定搭配：encourage sb to do sth, actively encourage
B(ordered)：语境句：The officer ordered the soldiers to stand in line. 固定搭配：order sb to do sth, in order
C(compared)：语境句：The teacher compared his writing style to that of Shakespeare. 固定搭配：compare A with/to B, compared to/with
D(meant)：语境句：I didn't quite catch what he meant by that comment. 固定搭配：be meant to be, mean doing sth

questions.explanation: 老师澄清说，这不是指狗，而是指这名特教学生第一次读得这么“流畅”(smoothly)。与前文男孩极度费力、结巴的表现形成鲜明对比。B(regularly)定期地；C(carefully)仔细地；D(silently)默默地。
questions.supplement:
A(smoothly)：语境句：Thanks to everyone's cooperation, the project went very smoothly. 固定搭配：go smoothly, run smoothly
B(regularly)：语境句：You need to exercise regularly to stay in good health. 固定搭配：check regularly, happen regularly
C(carefully)：语境句：He examined the rare painting carefully to verify its authenticity. 固定搭配：listen carefully, consider carefully
D(silently)：语境句：The cat crept silently across the room towards the mouse. 固定搭配：suffer silently, wait silently

questions.explanation: 让一个结巴、恐惧的特教孩子能够流利阅读并大声喊出单词，这是狗创造的微小的“奇迹”(miracles)。A(memories)记忆；C(sounds)声音；D(opportunities)机会。
questions.supplement:
A(memories)：语境句：The old photographs brought back many fond memories of my childhood. 固定搭配：fond memories, refresh one's memory
B(miracles)：语境句：It's a miracle that nobody was hurt in the terrible accident. 固定搭配：work miracles, perform a miracle
C(sounds)：语境句：The sounds of the city traffic kept him awake all night. 固定搭配：make a sound, sound familiar
D(opportunities)：语境句：The internet has created many new opportunities for small businesses. 固定搭配：seize an opportunity, miss an opportunity

questions.explanation: transform A into B 意为“把A转变为B”，狗把孩子们无声的恐惧“转变”成了勇敢的声音。A(persuaded)说服；B(broke)打破；C(brought)带来，均无法与into直接连用表示转化。
questions.supplement:
A(persuaded)：语境句：She persuaded her husband to quit smoking for the sake of his health. 固定搭配：persuade sb to do sth, persuade sb of sth
B(broke)：语境句：He accidentally broke the fragile vase into pieces. 固定搭配：break down, break into
C(brought)：语境句：The new policy has brought significant benefits to the local community. 固定搭配：bring about, bring up
D(transformed)：语境句：The caterpillar eventually transformed into a beautiful butterfly. 固定搭配：transform A into B, completely transform

questions.explanation: 随着时间流逝，孩子们逐渐长大“不再需要”(outgrew)图画书了，教室也换了海报，但那只红毛的倾听者却始终如一。outgrow 意为因长大而不再适用于/不需要某物。A(overlooked)忽略；B(downloaded)下载；D(undertook)承担。
questions.supplement:
A(overlooked)：语境句：His hard work was entirely overlooked by the management. 固定搭配：overlook a mistake, easily overlooked
B(downloaded)：语境句：I downloaded a new app to help me manage my schedule. 固定搭配：download from, illegally download
C(outgrew)：语境句：My son quickly outgrew the clothes we bought him last year. 固定搭配：outgrow one's clothes, outgrow a habit
D(undertook)：语境句：He undertook the responsibility of organizing the annual charity event. 固定搭配：undertake a task, undertake to do sth

section_2_word_form.passage:
The winter holiday season shines with decorations and lights. It is this time of year when Harbin, known as the city of ice, becomes a winter wonderland [56] in silver and white.
In Harbin, [57] catches our eyes and leaves us stunned is its ice sculptures, which are more than frozen art, but a symbol of human wisdom, proving that even in the extreme cold, beauty can thrive.
On the frozen Songhua River, the only source of crystal-clear and bubble-free ice, workers are busy harvesting thousands of cubic meters of ice [58] the splendid Harbin Ice and Snow World. They slice the surface into blocks of the same size, each [59] 700 kg. At the construction site, to support massive structures like twin ice towers, engineers first build steel frames up to 40 meters tall, around which ice blocks [60] like bricks. Then they fill the gaps [61] frames and blocks with ice and water, which freeze [62] to rock-solid walls. For unique structures, workers apply water mixed with paper pulp(纸浆) onto a blown-up mould(模具), creating ice three times stronger than normal. Days later, the mould is removed, revealing [63] amazing, durable creation. LED lights are embedded in carved sinks, layer by layer, changing sculptures into glowing wonders.
Despite immense [64] — slippery surfaces, -25℃ and time limits, the teams work 24/7 in shifts. Their dedication turns raw ice into breathtaking art — the art [65] is momentary, but the experience and the delicate beauty will last forever.

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构可知，此处作后置定语修饰wonderland，wonderland与wrap之间是被动关系（被包裹在银装素裹中），故填过去分词wrapped。
questions.supplement: 正确形(wrapped)：语境句：The present was beautifully wrapped in gold paper. 固定搭配：be wrapped in, wrap up。原词wrap其它变形：wrapping(n.), wrapper(n.)

questions.explanation: 此处引导主语从句，并在从句“__ catches our eyes...”中充当主语，指代引起注意的事物，故用代词What。句首注意首字母大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(What)：语境句：What we need most right now is more time. 固定搭配：what about, no matter what。原词what其它变形：whatever(pron./adj.), somewhat(adv.)

questions.explanation: 工人们忙着采集数以千计立方米的冰块，其目的是为了“建造”冰雪大世界。表示目的应用动词不定式。
knowledge_points: 动词不定式作目的状语
questions.supplement: 正确形(to build)：语境句：They are raising funds to build a new hospital in the village. 固定搭配：build up, build on。原词build其它变形：building(n.), builder(n.), rebuilt(v.)

questions.explanation: 此处为独立主格结构“逻辑主语 each + 分词”。each与weigh之间是主动关系（每块重达700公斤），故填现在分词weighing。
questions.supplement: 正确形(weighing)：语境句：He caught a huge fish weighing over twenty pounds. 固定搭配：weigh in, weigh one's words。原词weigh其它变形：weight(n.), weighty(adj.), weightless(adj.)

questions.explanation: 这是一个以which引导的定语从句，先行词为steel frames。从句的主语是ice blocks（复数），动词pile（堆放）与冰块之间为被动关系。文章时态为一般现在时，故填are piled。
questions.supplement: 正确形(are piled)：语境句：Books are piled high on his desk. 固定搭配：pile up, a pile of。原词pile其它变形：piled(adj.), piling(n.)

questions.explanation: 句意为：然后他们用冰和水填补钢架和冰块“之间”的空隙。常见固定搭配 between A and B 意为在A和B两者之间。
questions.supplement: 正确形(between)：语境句：There is a clear distinction between the two concepts. 固定搭配：between A and B, in between。原词between其它变形：无特殊变形

questions.explanation: 此处修饰动词freeze，意为“瞬间冻结”，需要用副词形式，故将形容词instant变为副词instantly。
questions.supplement: 正确形(instantly)：语境句：The driver was killed instantly in the violent crash. 固定搭配：react instantly, recognize instantly。原词instant其它变形：instant(adj./n.), instance(n.)

questions.explanation: creation在此处指代“一件作品”，为可数名词单数。其前面的修饰语amazing以元音音素开头，故需填入不定冠词an表示泛指“一个”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(an)：语境句：It was an absolute honor to meet the famous author. 固定搭配：an hour, an apple。原词an无特殊变形，为冠词(a/an)

questions.explanation: challenge作“挑战”解为可数名词。根据破折号后列举的内容（湿滑的表面、-25℃的低温、时间限制）可知，工人们面临着多重挑战，故使用复数形式challenges。
questions.supplement: 正确形(challenges)：语境句：We must be prepared to face any challenges ahead. 固定搭配：face a challenge, overcome challenges。原词challenge其它变形：challenging(adj.), challenged(adj.)

questions.explanation: 句意：艺术“本身”是短暂的，但体验和美感将永存。此处填反身代词itself作主语the art的同位语，起强调作用。
questions.supplement: 正确形(itself)：语境句：The town itself is very small, but its surroundings are beautiful. 固定搭配：by itself, in itself。原词it其它变形：its(pron.), itself(pron.)
